spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (पशति-ते) r. 10th cl. (पाशयति पशयति)
1 To bind, to fetter.
2 To knot or tie.
3 To go, to move.
4 To hinder or obstruct.
5 To touch.

r. 10th cl. (पाषयति पषयति)
1 To bind, to tie.
2 To move.
3 To oppose, to hinder.
4 To touch.

r. 1st and 10th cls. (पसति-ते पासयति पसयति)
1 To bind, to fetter, to tie, to string.
2 To touch.
3 To oppose, to obstruct, to hinder.
4 To go, to move.
5 To injure or kill.
(इ) पसि r. 1st and 10th cls. (पंसति पंसयति)
To annual, to annihilate or destroy.

m. (-शः)
1 A fetter, a chain, a tye, the string for fastening tamed animals, or the net or noose for catching birds, deer, &c.
2 A noose as a weapon of combat.
3 In composition with words signifying hair, quantity, as केशपाशः much or flowing hair.
4 In composition with कर्ण, beauty, as कर्णपाशः a handsome ear.
5 In composition with छत्र and other woods, depreciation, as छत्रपाशः an inelegant or shabby umbrella.
E.
पश to bind, aff. घञ्; where it is used in composition, it is in fact but a technical aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 Fit or advantageous for cattle, (meadow, pasturage, &c.)
2 Possessed of cattle.
E.
पशु, and यत् aff.

m. (-शुः)
1 An animal in general, a beast.
2 A goat.
3 A subordinate deity, and one of ŚIVA'S followers.
4 Any living being.
5 A sacrifice, an oblation.
6 The divine soul of the universe.
7 The glomerous fig tree.
ind.
See, behold.
E.
दृश to see, पश substituted, and कु Uṇādi aff.

f. (-का)
Any small animal.
E.
पशु, and कन् dimin. aff.

f. (-या)
Copulation, coition.
E.
पशु an animal, and क्रिया action.

f. (-त्री)
A parody of the holy verse of the Vedas, whispered into the ear of an animal about to be sacrificed.
E.
पशु, and गायत्री the Gāyatrī.

n. (-तं)
Slaughter of animals for sacrifice, &c.
E.
पशु, and घात killing.

f. (-ता)
The condition or nature of an animal, bestiality, brutality.
E.
तल् added to पशु.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Sacrifice of an animal.
2 Nature of an animal.
E.
पशु, and त्व aff.

m. (-र्म्मः)
1 Action or property of animals.
2 Promiscuous cohabitation.
3 The marrying of widows.
E.
पशु, and धर्म्म office.

m. (-तिः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
पशु living creature, and पति the master, the creator, or preserver; or पशु ŚIVA'S attendant, and पति master; or according to one legend, पशु an animal, which every deity acknowledged himself to be before his lord and master ŚIVA, when they solicited him to destroy the Asura TRIPURA.

n. (-लं)
A fragrant, grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)

m. (-लः)
A herdsman.
E.
पशु, and पाल who cherishes.

n. (-नं)
Tending or rearing cattle.
E.
पशु, and पालन protecting.

n. (-णं)
Driving cattle.
E.
पशु a beast, प्रेरण sending.

m. (-गः)
Sacrifice of animals.
E.
पशु, and याग sacrifice.

n. (-णं)
Tending cattle.
E.
पशु, and रक्षण preserving.

m. (-क्षी)
A herdsman, a shepherd.
E.
पशु, and रक्षिन् who guards.

m. (-ज्जुः)
A string or tie for fastening cattle.
E.
पशु an animal, and ज्जु a rope.

m. (-जः)
A lion.
E.
पशु a beast, and राज sovereign.

n. (-म)
The hair of an animal.
E.
पशु, and रोमन् hair of the body.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Produced by an animal, (flesh, honey, butter, &c.)
E.
पशु, and सम्भव product.

f. (-की)
The hog plum.
E.
पशु an animal, हरीतकी myrobalan.

n. (-व्यं)
Sacrifice of animals.
E.
पशु, and हव्य oblation.

ind.
After, afterwards, behind, westward.
E.
पश्च considered as a substitute for अपर, and आति aff.

m. (-पः)
Repentance.
E.
पश्चात् afterwards, ताप sorrow.

mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धा-र्द्धं)
The remaining half or part of any thing.
E.
पश्व for अपर, and अर्द्ध a part.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 West, western.
2 Behind, after.
mf. (-मः-मा)
The region of VARUṆA, the west.
E.
पश्चात् behind, and डिमच् aff.; Hindus in their prayers, usually facing the east, and consequently having the west behind them.

ind.
An exclamation of wonder or admiration, (lo, behold, see.)
E.
दृश to see, deriv. irr.; also पश्यतु and पशु.

mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं)
Who or what sees.
E.
पश्य for दृश to see, श aff.

f. (-श्या)
A number of nooses.
E.
पाश, and यत् aff.

mfn. (-श्यन्-श्यन्ती-श्यत्)
1 Looking, seeing.
2 Remarking, considering.
f. (-न्ती)
A harlot, a courtezan.
E.
दृश to see, शतृ aff. of the present participle, and root irr.

ind.
Visibly, in sight.
E.
पश्य, and तसि aff.

m. (-रः)
A thief, a pilferer, but one who steals in presence of the parties, and proverbially applied to the goldsmith, &c.
E.
पश्यतस् in presence of, and हर who takes.

n. (-नं)
Sacrifice or offering of animals.
E.
पशु, and अवदान oblation.

m. (-रः)
Worship of DEVI.
E.
पशु, and आचार instituted observance.

n. (-स्त्यं)
A house.
E.
स्त्यै to collect, अप् prefixed, deriv. irr.

m. (-कः)
A dice, particularly the long sort used in playing Chaupai.
E.
पश to bind, ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-कः)
An ornament for the feet.

m. (-णिः)
A name of VARUṆA, the regent of water.
E.
पाश a sort of noose, and पाणि the hand, VARUṆA being represented as holding a cord in one hand, shaped like a sling or a noose.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Noosed, snared, caught or bound.
E.
पाश, and बद्ध bound.

n. (-न्धं)
A noose, a snare, a halter, a net, &c.
E.
पाश, and बन्ध a binding.

m. (-भृत्)
1 VARUṆ

A soldier, &c. armed with a noose.
E.
पाश, and भृत् who has.

n. (-वं)
A flock, a herd.
E.
पशु an animal, अण् aff.

n. (-नं)
Pasturage or meadow grass.
E.
पाशव, and पालन supporting.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Tied, fettered, bound.
E.
पाश a fetter, and इतच् aff.

m. (-शी)
1 One armed with a net or noose.
2 A deer-catcher or fowler, using a net or noose.
3 A name of VARUṆ

A name of YAMA.
E.
पाश a fetter, इनि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Tied, fettered.
E.
पाश a fetter, कृत made, and ई substituted for the final of the first word.

m. (-तः)
1 A follower and worshipper of ŚIVA, in one of his forms as the supreme deity of the Hindū triad.
2 A tree, (Æschynomene grandiflora.)
E.
पशुपति a name of ŚIVA, अण् aff.

n. (-स्त्रं)
ŚIVA'S trident.
E.
पाशुपत, and अस्त्र a weapon.

n. (-ल्यं)
The business of a grazier, rearing and keeping cattle.
E.
पशु an animal, पाल nourishing, ष्यञ् aff.

mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
1 Behind, being behind.
2

Subsequent.
3

Western.
E.
पश्चात्, and जा aff.

m. (-ण्डः)
1 A heretick, an impostor, one who not conforming to the orthodox tenets of Hindū faith, assumes the external characteristicks of tribe or sect, a Jain, a Bauddha, &c.
2 Any sect not Hindū.
E.
पाप sin, षण to give, ड aff., deriv. irr.

m. (-कः)
A heretick, an impostor.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-ण्डी)
A heretick, &c.: see पाषण्ड.
E.
पाषण्ड, and इनि added.

m. (-णः)
A stone in general.
f. (-णी)
A small stone used as a weight.
E.
पिश to grind, (condiments upon,) घञ् aff. आनच् added, and the deriv. irr.

m. (-कः)
A sort of hatchet for cutting stones, a stonecutter's chisel.
E.
पाषाण a stone, and दारक what tears or breaks; also पाषाणदारण, from दारण rending, tearing.

m. (-णः)
An instrument for cutting stones; see the last.

m. (-दी)
A plant, (Plectranthus scutellaroides.)
E.
पाषाण a stone, and भेदिन् dividing; growing amongst stones and rocks.
